name: mcp-instagram
description: Read Instagram profiles, posts, stories and comments, and like, comment and follow.
long_description: Unofficial Instagram integration built on instagram-private-api. Instagram may flag or restrict accounts used through unofficial APIs, so prefer a secondary account. Write actions (likes, comments, follows) are rate limited by the server. You log in with the session cookie of a logged-in instagram.com browser session (no password needed); the session is saved privately in ~/.config/mcp-instagram (or %APPDATA%\mcp-instagram on Windows).

ig_session_id.title: Instagram session ID
ig_session_id.description: The value of the `sessionid` cookie from instagram.com in a browser where you are logged in. Treat it like a password.

ig_username.title: Instagram username
ig_username.description: Optional. If set, a session for a different account is refused.

ig_password.title: Instagram password
ig_password.description: Optional; password login is currently unavailable because Instagram changed its login flow. Never written to disk.
